about: The mantle sheet's ten worn views registered to the low-poly bodies (tools/sculpt/lowmantlereg.mjs project): screen x = cx + s ax (cos yaw x + sin yaw z), screen y = cy - s y, in the sheet's pixels (mantle-sheet.png, 1536 x 1024). s per row from the head's height and the chin (hers 0.85 of his, as the game draws her); cx, cy per view from the head's top and, where it shows, the chin (lowmantlesheet.py heads); ax, dy the per-view corrections fitted to the shoulders' outline (lowmantlereg.mjs).
